title: UPI onboarded 55.49 crore users by June 2026, transactions reach US$ 3.56 trillion in FY26
description: UPI onboarded 55.49 crore users by June 2026 and processed transactions worth Rs. 314.23 lakh crore (US$ 3.56 trillion) in FY26, reflecting the continued expansion of India's digital payments ecosystem.
